nodes.label: Latency Budgets (v2)
nodes.rationale: First partial visible ≤500ms after first speech; key-up → final inserted ≤800ms; cold-start penalty 0 (amortized at startup via warm_up); cleanup tail ≤40% of v1; audio callback p99 ≤5ms; streaming-ASR memory churn bounded by window (window_s * sample_rate * 4B per partial).

nodes.label: v0.3.6 Performance Optimizations (R2–R6)
nodes.rationale: R2: dedicated VAD worker thread off the audio callback. R3: defer finalization off the audio thread. R4: memoryview + single .copy() for the streaming window. R5: chunker _get_delta deletes emitted bytes (del self._buffer[:end]). R6: cancel wired to in-flight pipeline task via Orchestrator.cancel().

nodes.label: Benchmark Harness (scripts/benchmark.py)
nodes.rationale: scripts/benchmark.py — mock mode enforces MOCK_BUDGETS_MS budgets and is CI-gated; real mode uses faster_whisper+rules over WAV fixtures in tests/fixtures/audio/ and reports only. Mock exists to catch gross regressions in pipeline glue, not to micro-benchmark.

nodes.label: Dedicated VAD Worker Thread (R2)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism: silero VAD inference runs on a dedicated daemon thread (agentvoca-vad); the sounddevice audio callback only enqueues a tuple and reads a cached bool. Enforced by tests/unit/test_capture_vad_worker.py::test_callback_p99_under_5ms_with_slow_inference. Fixes the OBS-0 bug: app.mode: auto_stop had silently never worked since v0.3.0 because VAD inference was running inline in the audio callback.
